ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) surface with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) punctate pixels scattered across both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed white punctate mottling across the central and upper regions of both lobes; dense dark-toned, high-texture clusters (barnacles) located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior pixel angle of 45 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-12 pixels; serrations are more pronounced on the inner half of each lobe towards the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning into a sharp upward and outward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density of small, circular white pixel clusters (punctate scars) distributed across the central area of both fluke lobes; dense dark textured masses localized at the lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, short diagonal white linear disruptions visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive stalked and acorn barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema/Conchoderma auritum) forming large, dark, protruding clusters at the tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water droplets and spray shedding from the right fluke tip, creating high-contrast white trails against the grey background.
